excluded_conflicting_packages.php5.6-gmagick: Imagick selected; Gmagick conflicts with the Imagick virtual package.
excluded_conflicting_packages.php5.6-smbclient: MongoDB selected; SMBClient plus MongoDB crashed during SASL cleanup on native 16.04/18.04 tests.
excluded_conflicting_packages.php5.6-uploadprogress: Core session upload progress selected; this PECL extension replaces its multipart callback and breaks the counter regression check.
excluded_conflicting_packages.php5.6-xcache: APCu and OPcache selected; Xcache is an alternative cache.
excluded_conflicting_packages.php5.6-yac: APCu selected; YAC conflicts with the APCu virtual package.

limits: No representative third-party application or production workload.
External service tests use local Memcached/Redis; other backend integrations are bounded smoke checks.
No fresh OS reinstall, independent application-server upgrade or snapshot rollback test.
The complete historical PHP PHPT suite was not run.
No representative application/production workload; no external MongoDB, SMB, AMQP, SQL database or other remote backend integration.
Extension smoke checks are bounded and do not prove every feature or security property.
Reversing the MongoDB/SMBClient load order avoided the minimal crash, but is not a validated deployment workaround.
Raw native logs and host package inventory are retained privately; this export omits host identities and private paths.
